  <action>
Update the game entry point to register all subsystems built in Plans 05-14.

```kotlin
object LabyrinthOfTheDragon {
    fun create() = game("LabyrinthDragon") {
        config {
            cartridge = "MBC5_RAM_BATTERY"
            romBanks = 32
            ramBanks = 4
        }

        // State variables (from GameState.kt)
        GameState.register(this)

        // Sound effects
        Sounds.register(this)

        // Palettes (GBC)
        Palettes.register(this)

        // Status icons
        StatusIcons.register(this)

        // RPG entities (order matters: effects → items → characters → monsters → abilities → combat)
        StatusEffects.register(this)
        Items.register(this)
        Characters.register(this)
        Monsters.register(this)
        Abilities.register(this)
        CombatSystem.register(this)

        // Save system
        SaveSystem.register(this)

        // World (flags + 8 floors + exploration)
        Floors.register(this)

        // Exploration system
        exploration {
            preset(ExplorationPreset.DUNGEON_CRAWLER)
            startZone(Floors.floor1)
            gauge("torch") {
                max(GameConfig.TORCH_MAX)
                initial(GameConfig.TORCH_MAX)
                decrementPerStep(1)
                onLow(GameConfig.TORCH_LOW_THRESHOLD) { showMessage("Torch dimming...") }
                onDepleted { navigate(Scenes.gameOverRef) }
            }
            keys("magic_key") { max(99); initial(0) }
            onStep { /* encounter check */ }
            onInteract { tryInteractWithObject(state.currentFloor, state.playerX, state.playerY) }
        }

        // Scenes (last — they reference everything above)
        Scenes.register(this)
        start = Scenes.titleRef.id
    }
}
```

Ensure all register() calls are in the correct order (dependencies before dependents). The game builder must produce valid IR that passes structure validation.
